summary: Expose evidence selection plans and explicit backlog export through recommend

delivery.outcome: Expose explicit evidence selection planning and local review backlog through the existing recommend command; preserve legacy recommend/register/fleet behavior and publish through protected independent review and merge.
nonGoals: No installation, adoption or implicit external effects
No changes outside the accepted slice

architecture.decision: Bridge merged query API to recommend through an opt-in selection-plan mode with explicit pinned catalog, bounded data-only inputs and live freshness checks. Reuse existing fleet exporter only on an explicit export request.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of this additive slice.

validation.evidence: New recommendation mode produces explained schema-valid plans and rejects stale or incompatible input before effects; legacy recommend remains compatible.
Full tests and managed accepted-base gate pass; independent protected approval and merge bind exact head.
